property_summary: For any address proposal created via newAddressProposal, the stored mapPID_address must equal the caller-supplied proposedAddress; the bug always stores address(0) instead, breaking the rule for any non-zero input.
change_summary: Replace mapPID_address[proposalCount] = proposedAddress with mapPID_address[proposalCount] = address(0), so the stored address is always zero instead of the caller's input.
